rows.title: Germinal identification page: 'Description of the goods' caption and the 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' column
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Identification details captions its heading 'Description of the goods', and its 'Selected commodities' summary heads the count column 'Quantity (unit/pieces)', showing each species row's own saved quantity. The live animals page keeps 'Number of animals'. Each set holds one category, so the germinal page always shows these.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal identification page's heading carries the caption 'Description of the goods'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-075; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-006)

On the germinal identification page the 'Selected commodities' quantity column is headed 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' and shows each species row's own saved quantity, while the live animals identification page heads the same column 'Number of animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-071; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-057, -p1-110; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-003, -p1-004; c-234)
rows.notes: This area's draft of the existing germinal identification page row. Combines the caption (req-2614) and the quantity column heading (req-1776): both are copy on the germinal set's identification page, one page and one walk. c-234 makes the quantity in units or pieces each species' own count. The germinal set's folder is built by the germinal-products theme's earlier rows; the live animals identification page sits in the split-off identification-and-permanent-address theme, and this row only reads that its column stays 'Number of animals'.

rows.title: Germinal identification dates with a 'Choose date' calendar, and the format, real-date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal identification page the collection and production dates are each a text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', enhanced by the shared Ministry of Justice 'Choose date' calendar, so the page still works without JavaScript. Each date must be given as day/month/four-digit year and be a real date; no range rule applies and the production date is never compared with the collection date. The identification number or mark is capped at 58 characters.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', and both can be typed in and saved with JavaScript turned off, reading back exactly as typed. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-020, -p5-023, -p5-111; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-074, -p2-075; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091, -p1-092)

Each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle that opens a month grid, and picking a day fills that date's text input with the day, month and four-digit year. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-075-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-057, -p5-058, -p5-073; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-014, -p1-039, -p1-040, -p1-042, -p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-012, -p1-023)

An identification number or mark over 58 characters shows 'Identification number/mark must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline on the field; 58 characters save. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-064; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date not given as day/month/four-digit year, such as 2026-09-01, shows 'Enter a collection date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-079, -p2-080; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-065; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date not given as day/month/four-digit year, such as 2026-09-01, shows 'Enter a production date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date in the right form that is not a real date, such as 99/99/2026, shows 'Collection date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-077; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date in the right form that is not a real date, such as 31/02/2026, shows 'Production date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date of 1/9/2026, dates in the past, dates in the future and a production date earlier than the collection date all save with no error and read back exactly as entered. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-079, -p2-080; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-011, -p1-012)
rows.notes: This area's draft of the existing germinal identification dates row. Combines the calendar date fields (req-252), the identification number length check (req-255), the two format checks (req-256, req-257) and the two real-date checks (req-258, req-259): one page, one validator set, one germinal walk. The cross-area restatements in the same existing row state the same rules, so the combiner keeps one criterion per pair. The calendar is the shared Ministry of Justice date field the live dates already use; its styles belong to the split-off design-snagging theme and this row only uses it, editing no shared file.
